decisions.reason: As a product that builds directly on the firm's core finishing portfolio, remains on its own webpage across two years, and fits the publicly stated move toward automated connected workflows, management is likely to stay committed and interpret any weaker uptake as temporary rather than exit quickly.

Although less prominently presented than Product C, this close-to-core add-on has a visible reference installation and supports the firm's automation and inline efficiency promise, so escalation of commitment and strategic fit make continued marketing more likely than withdrawal.
